articles.title: Woman, man wanted in connection with alleged robbery in Scarborough
articles.summary: Toronto police are searching for a man and a woman in connection with an alleged robbery in Scarborough. articles.title: After Trump ban, MS NOW and CNN say their journalists were denied access to White House
articles.summary: NEW YORK (AP) — Two major news networks were denied access to the White House on Saturday morning, with reporters from CNN and MS NOW both going live to report they'd been barred following a ban imposed by President Donald Trump.

articles.title: Police investigate after Markham home riddled with bullets early Saturday
articles.summary: Police in York Region are searching for at least two suspects after gunfire erupted at a home in Markham early Saturday morning. Investigators say two males wearing all black walked up the driveway of a home in the Warden Avenue and Highway 7 area just after 2 a.m. and fired multiple rounds at the residence […]

articles.title: Two people seriously injured in early morning stabbing
articles.summary: Toronto police are searching for up to four suspects following an early morning stabbing in the city’s west end. Investigators say they located two people suffering from stab wounds just before 2:30 a.m. on St. Clair Avenue West near Dufferin Street. Paramedics tell CityNews they were taken to the hospital with serious but non-life-threatening injuries. […]

articles.title: Candidates in Toronto's east end are arguing over a Gardiner ramp that doesn't exist anymore
articles.summary: A years-gone ramp on the Gardiner Expressway is haunting the race for city councillor in Toronto’s east end, with some candidates saying another’s promise to resurrect it is just smoke and mirrors.

articles.title: Artists in Durham Region gear up for annual free festival featuring 'symphony' of arts
articles.summary: Artists across Durham Region are preparing for a free festival next month that’s in its 45th year of showcasing local talent.

articles.title: Motorcyclist, 74, dies after single-vehicle crash in Vaughan
articles.summary: A motorcyclist has died after a single-vehicle crash in Vaughan on Friday evening, Ontario provincial police say.

articles.title: Man, 61, dead after car and dump truck collide in Caledon, police say
articles.summary: A 61-year-old man is dead after a car and dump truck collided in Caledon early Friday, police say.

articles.title: 'Don't close, don't sell': Union implores Stellantis to keep Brampton plant as automaker signals sale
articles.summary: The union representing Canadian workers at Stellantis is urging the automaker to keep its commitment to retooling its Brampton Ont., plant as the company looks poised to sell it instead.
